subject: Registrant export + retention plan for ON24 & Zoom streams
messages:
From: Sophie Ramos <sophie@on24.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ON24 registrant export options for your July 28 webinar

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the heads up on the July 28 webinar. I pulled together the export options so your ops/legal team can confirm retention and PII fields:  

- Standard CSV export (email, first/last name, company, title, registration time).
- De-identified export (hashes for email, first/last name removed) — requires signed DPA addendum.
- Field-mapping export (custom field names + utm tags).

I've attached a sample field map and a short sandbox creds file you can use to test (see attachments). If ProspectCo needs records longer than 90 days we should document that in the MA/feature addendum — otherwise ON24 retains default 12 months.

Can you confirm which export format you want and whether ProspectCo has a retention exception request? I can provision the sandbox export for a test tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Sophie Ramos
Partnerships — ON24
Sophie@on24.com

Attachments: export_field_map.xlsx (xlsx), on24_sandbox_credentials.txt (txt)

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: ON24 registrant export options for your July 28 webinar

Thanks Sophie — quick context from our side: ProspectCo (the sponsor) has asked to retain registrant records for 18 months for post-event lead gen; legal is already reviewing. Two quick asks from ops/security:  

1) We need to validate the export includes UTM parameters and custom field "account_tier" (we use that to attach lead scoring).
2) Confirm how ON24 handles Zoom RTMP-forwarded registrants — do those appear in the same export or separate logs?

Marissa/Ben — looping you in to coordinate a short export test tomorrow (anytime after 2pm PT works for me). Grace — can you confirm whether retaining hashed emails (de-identified) would satisfy ProspectCo's data needs pending legal sign-off? If legal wants plain emails for 18 months we may need a contractual exception.

If everyone is aligned I'll ask Sophie to run the sandbox export and we'll validate field mapping against our CRM.

Thanks —
Tessa
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: ON24 registrant export options for your July 28 webinar

Hi team — quick note from Zoom: when a Zoom session forwards via RTMP to a third party (ON24) the registrant source is recorded on the Zoom side but ON24 may ingest it as a new registrant depending on mapping. Best practice is to have ON24 include the original Zoom registrant_id and a source field (zoom_rtmp) in the export so you can de-dupe during ingestion.

I'll also export a small sample from our tenant for the same session and drop it into the compliance bucket for your ops team to compare. Expect that export within 2 hours.

Samir
Customer Success — Zoom Integrations

Subject: Export test complete — sample uploaded + next steps

Hi all —

I ran the sandbox export from ON24 (Sophie provided creds). Attached is a 100-row sample (export_field_map.xlsx) and I also uploaded the Zoom tenant sample to the compliance bucket for comparison. Quick findings:

- ON24 export includes utm_source/utm_medium and a field labeled registrant_id.
- Emails are present in plain text in the ON24 sample (no hashing option enabled for this export).
- There is a field called "source_platform" with values: "direct", "onpage", "zoom_rtmp" — looks good for de-duping.

Next steps:
1) Grace/legal to confirm whether hashed emails suffice for ProspectCo’s 18-month ask or if a contractual exception is required.
2) If legal requires plain emails, we'll prepare a short addendum to the MA and record the retention exception in the ticket (Jira:EVT-1123).
3) Ops to finalize CRM mapping by Wed EOD once legal confirms.

Attachments: export_field_map.xlsx (sample) — available in thread.

Thanks —
Ben
Events Platform Engineer
Redwood Inference
